dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Mr.305 is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Mr 305 has been observed to be kennel reactive and rope reactive. While on leash, he is noted to jump up, bite, and tug on the leash. This behavior is not easily redirected with treats or squeaky sounds. In kennel, Mr 305 is reported to jump towards the handler's hand and then will begin biting and tugging the leash into the kennel. This behavior is also difficult to redirect. With handlers, Mr 305 is social, allows petting, and is receptive to treats. Medically, Mr 305 is apparently healthy.

Mr. 305 arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, 305 has been observed to be kennel reactive, noted to pull towards the other dogs while barking. While on leash, 305 has been observed to jump up, bite, and tug on the leash. This behavior is not redirected easily with treats or squeaky sounds. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home with no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Mr.305
